drums.tags: Indie rock instrumental. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, palm-muted eighth-note riff on the lower strings, establishing a rhythmic ostinato. A second electric guitar with a slightly overdriven tone and chorus effect enters with a melodic lead line featuring slides and sustained notes. The electric bass follows the root notes of the guitar riff in a steady eighth-note pattern. The drum kit maintains a straightforward backbeat with a closed hi-hat and a dry snare sound. The track is in the key of E major with a tempo of 115 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the two guitar layers and the driving rhythm section.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[palm-muted electric guitar riff enters]
[electric bass enters, doubling the guitar rhythm]

[Main Theme]
[clean electric guitar with chorus effect plays melodic lead line]
[drum kit enters with steady backbeat and closed hi-hats]

[Bridge]
[lead guitar plays sustained notes with slides]
[rhythm guitar continues palm-muted eighth-note pattern]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[palm-muted guitar riff fades out]

bass.tags: Industrial noise and sound design piece. The track features heavy mechanical textures, including rhythmic metallic scraping, high-frequency digital glitches, and deep sub-bass impacts. Distorted white noise bursts and granular synthesis textures create a dense, abrasive atmosphere. A recurring low-end thud functions as a rhythmic anchor, while sharp, percussive transients mimic the sound of industrial machinery. The piece utilizes extreme dynamic shifts and stereo panning for spatial disorientation. Heavy saturation and bit-crushing effects are applied to the mid-range frequencies.
